title: Resurrection after death
intro: Allah, who created us the first time, will bring us back to life.

learn.html: A Muslim believes in ba‘th – being brought back to life after death. When the Sur is blown the second time, Allah will raise every person who ever lived, with body and soul.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: When people asked how dry bones could live again, Allah answered: the One who created them the first time will give them life again. (Qur’an, Ya-Sin 36:78–79)

items.label: Ba‘th – everyone is brought back to life
Hashr – all people are gathered in one place
The books of deeds – given in the right hand or the left
Hisab – the reckoning: Allah judges with complete justice

learn.title: The book of deeds
learn.html: The angels Kiraman Katibin write down everything we do. On that Day each person receives their book: the believers in the right hand – full of joy – and the others in the left.

learn.title: Signs around us
learn.html: Every spring Allah brings dry earth back to life with rain. In the same way He will bring people back to life. <small>(Qur’an, Fussilat 41:39)</small>

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Nothing is hard for Allah. He made us from nothing, so bringing us back is easy for Him.

practice.title: The Day of Resurrection in order
items: The second blowing of the Sur
Ba‘th – everyone is brought back to life
The books of deeds are given
